original: 私たちは少なくとも月に一冊本を読むべきだ。

en.text: We should read one book a month at least.
We should read at least one book a month.

indices: 私たち は 少なくとも 月(つき)[02] に 一冊 本(ほん)[01] を 読む 可き{べき} だ

original: 古本屋で偶然出会った一冊が、今では一番のお気に入りだ。

en.text: A book I happened to come across at a secondhand bookstore has now become my favorite.
